text:
noah: quick ping — PR #2145 is up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2145. It's the REST/JS client change to surface tool-calling timeout + streaming reentrancy fix. Can someone take a look when you have a minute? branch=feat/sdk-toolcall-params :eyes:

ci-bot: CI started for sha=7f3b2d. Tests: unit, integration, lint. Approx ETA 6m.

maya: thanks! I'll grab it. high level: is this a breaking change for the SDK consumers or additive?

noah: it's additive by default — new optional param `toolTimeoutMs` on the call options. existing behavior unchanged. streaming fix touches the chunking logic but preserves wire protocol. added a migration note in CHANGELOG.

raj: skimmed the diff. small question: in clients/rest/index.ts you switched `sendToolCall` to return `{ status, result }` instead of raw response. Was that to normalize errors? might affect a couple of internal call sites.

noah: yes, normalizing to make downstream retries easier. I updated two internal call sites in the same PR (`agent-runner` & `rlhf-worker`) but left public SDK docs. If we want, I can add a compatibility shim that returns raw when `raw=true`.

akeem: can we avoid API churn? if adding a `raw` flag is cheap, do it. Otherwise note in changelog and bump minor semver.

noah: will add `raw` flag — good catch.

ci-bot: CI: unit passed ✅, lint passed ✅, integration failed ❌ — failure in `streaming-client.e2e` (timeout). 

maya: hmm failing e2e streaming is worrying. is that flaky or introduced here? logs point to `kv-cache` eviction happening earlier.

raj: I ran the failing test locally against this branch; it flakes intermittently. looks like a timing window with the new chunk coalescing. Try increasing the test timeout or adding a small sleep in the test harness?

noah: I added a test-only backoff in the branch to make it stable. pushed fix: sha=7f3b2d -> 9a1c4f. Restarting CI.

ci-bot: CI restarted for sha=9a1c4f.

ci-bot: All checks passed ✅ (unit, integration, lint).

maya: nice. I'd like one API owner to approve the `sendToolCall` change — @raj are you good with the normalization + `raw` shim?

raj: yep LGTM. small nit: add a short comment in `rest/index.ts` explaining why normalization exists (retries + consistent error shape). other than that, ship it. :shipit:

akeem: giving a quick +1 from me too. Please add the `CHANGELOG` line under `Unreleased` with the migration note.

noah: will add comment & changelog line in a follow-up commit, then merge. Planning to merge before the maintenance window at 2026-03-12 22:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: Heads up — maintenance window tonight 22:00-23:30 UTC. Anything merged before 21:45 will get included in the pre-window deploy.

noah: merging after CI now. thanks y'all! :tada:

maya: thanks — will watch the deploy.

raj: nice work, noah.

akeem: :thumbsup:
